kinds.label: Variance to plan
kinds.question: Which units are off plan beyond tolerance, why, and who acts on each one?
kinds.value_formula: variance beyond tolerance recovered: (plan - actual) on the units {owner} acts on, from {signal_columns}; current estimate {value_at_stake}
kinds.serving_template: A performance explainer for {owner} that shows where {kpi} moved, why, and which {objects} need an owner: app, dashboard, Genie room, alert.

method_plain.Decomposition: Decomposition: the change in {kpi} is split into price, volume, mix and other steps from {signal_columns}.
method_plain.Regression Analysis: Regression: the effect of each driver in {signal_columns} on {kpi} is estimated with its interval.
method_plain.Trend Analysis: Trend analysis: the change of {kpi} over time in {signal_columns} is measured with its significance.

kinds.strip_must_remain: a driver bridge from plan to actual, a tolerance per unit, and an owner and action for each unit outside it

questions: Which {objects} are furthest below plan this period?
What explains the gap between plan and actual {kpi}?
Which {objects} have been outside tolerance for three periods in a row?
How much of the variance is price and how much is volume?
Which owner has the most {objects} off plan?

alerts.name: Variance outside tolerance
alerts.rule: count of {result_table}__variance rows with abs(variance) > tolerance in the latest period > {threshold}
alerts.sql: (SELECT COUNT_IF(abs(variance) > tolerance) FROM {result_table}__variance WHERE period = (SELECT MAX(period) FROM {result_table}__variance)) > {threshold}

kinds.demo_signal: a monthly plan or budget per unit with 8 units missing plan by more than 10% for 3 months, driven by volume

kinds.label: Driver breakdown
kinds.question: How much of the change in the measure came from price, volume and mix?
kinds.value_formula: the share of the change in {kpi} each driver explains, from {signal_columns}; current change {value_at_stake}
kinds.serving_template: A dashboard page for {owner} that shows {kpi} across {objects}, with a headline and Ask Genie on every widget: app, dashboard, Genie room, alert.

method_plain.Decomposition: Decomposition: the change in {kpi} is split into price, volume, mix and other steps from {signal_columns}.
method_plain.Pareto Analysis: Pareto analysis: {objects} are ranked by their share of {kpi} to find the few that drive most of it.
method_plain.Regression Analysis: Regression: the effect of each driver in {signal_columns} on {kpi} is estimated with its interval.

kinds.strip_must_remain: a price, volume and mix bridge that adds up to the total change, not a single total by period

questions: How much of the change in {kpi} came from price?

alerts.name: Driver shift
alerts.rule: abs(value) of the largest {result_table}__bridge step other than volume > {threshold} of the total change
alerts.sql: (SELECT MAX(abs(value)) FROM {result_table}__bridge WHERE lower(step_type) <> 'volume') > {threshold} * (SELECT SUM(abs(value)) FROM {result_table}__bridge)

kinds.demo_signal: a 5% price rise on one category offset by a 12% volume drop, with mix moving toward cheaper items

kinds.label: Peer benchmarking
